messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "1 to 2 weeks for improvement in sleep, appetite, or energy levels"
set: ["1 to 2 weeks for improvement in sleep, appetite, or energy levels", "2 to 3 weeks", "requires 1 to 2 weeks of regular dosing for full effect to build up", "1 to 2 week intervals", "up to 2 to 3 weeks", "tapering should occur for 2 weeks prior to discontinuation", "symptoms may not improve for up to 2 to 6 weeks", "it may take up to 2 weeks before your cholesterol levels improve", "if treatment needs to stop, prescriber will lower dose gradually over 1 to 2 weeks", "regimen continues for 1 to 2 days after completion of chemotherapy", "5 weeks or longer for full benefit in OCD", "taken for few days or weeks", "continued oral dosing for 1 to 2 days after completion of chemotherapy", "increase to 20 mg/day after 2 weeks for adolescents and higher-weight children", "This applies to patients taking 300 mg/day for at least 2 weeks", "dose given IV slowly over 1 to 2 minutes"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
